description: This Java class, LoanOfficerValidator, provides validation methods for assigning and unassigning loan officers to loan accounts within the Fineract system. It checks constraints such as date validity, ensuring that assignment and unassignment dates are not in the future and are logically consistent with previous records and loan submission dates.

classes.name: LoanOfficerValidator
classes.description: A component class responsible for validating the dates related to loan officer assignment and unassignment, ensuring proper sequence and preventing invalid date configurations.

methods.name: validateUnassignDate
methods.description: Validates that the unassignment date is not before the loan officer's start date and is not in the future.

methods.name: validateReassignment
methods.description: Validates that a loan officer reassignment date is after the loan's submission date and the previous unassignment date, and not in the future.

methods.name: validateAssignmentDateWithHistory
methods.description: Checks if the proposed new assignment date precedes any existing assignment history start date.
